Record maize harvest >4M tonnes — reduced food import needs

trendAnalysis.outlook: The kwacha firmed marginally, with the USD/ZMW market mid easing ~0.06% to ~K19.72/USD (open.er-api.com, 23 Sep) while the BoZ official mid sat at ~K19.54 (22 Sep). The pair remains inside the broad 18.40–19.80 consolidation band, and the move was broad-based across GBP, EUR, ZAR and BWP (all marginally lower in ZMW terms) with CNY likewise edging down — i.e. a modest, uniform kwacha firming. The official/parallel premium remains narrow, signalling no acute FX scarcity. With re-election formalised at the 1 Sep ceremony and the MPC holding at 13.25% on 26 August, focus shifts to the 30 Sep MPC — the same day a 10% copper-concentrate export duty takes effect — plus the 2027 budget and the make-up of the new economic team.
trendAnalysis.projection3m: USD/ZMW 18.50–19.80 range. Post-election policy continuity supportive; import demand and copper-price swings the main risks.
trendAnalysis.projection6m: USD/ZMW 18.00–20.00 range. Direction hinges on fiscal continuity and copper earnings.
